en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide urban avenue lined with multi‑story buildings featuring balconies and awnings. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and several mid‑20th‑century cars are parked or driving along the street. The photo is taken from an elevated vantage point looking down the avenue under a partly cloudy sky. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Alexandria, Fouad I Avenue, along with a reference number and a website.
